name: deepdeck
description: DeepDeck desktop client built on DeepSeek Harness
author: jo32

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm harness:install && pnpm harness:build && pnpm build
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-desktop-chrome run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-home-hero run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-agent-preset-sections run build && pnpm --filter @deepseek-harness/desktop run build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-desktop-chrome run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-home-hero run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-agent-preset-sections run check && pnpm --filter @deepseek-harness/desktop run check
scripts.package:local: pnpm build && pnpm runtime:prepare && node scripts/build-desktop-package.mjs --local && node scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs --local
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && pnpm runtime:prepare && node scripts/build-desktop-package.mjs --mac && node scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs --production
